name: DormCare Live Alerts
description: Real-world scenario for the publish-subscribe demo. A dormitory manager's office and a maintenance desk publish alerts for two Iloilo City properties (Casa Jaro Dormitory and Molo Bedspace Hub). Tenants and the caretaker subscribe only to the topics that concern them. Names, properties and notices are based on the DormCare prototype's sample data (app.js seed()).

topics.casa-jaro.announcements: House notices for Casa Jaro Dormitory tenants (inspections, water interruptions, house rules)
topics.casa-jaro.maintenance: Repair ticket updates for Casa Jaro Dormitory
topics.casa-jaro.billing: General rent and utility notices for Casa Jaro tenants (no personal balances: see the privacy note in the design document)
topics.molo-hub.announcements: House notices for Molo Bedspace Hub tenants
topics.molo-hub.maintenance: Repair ticket updates for Molo Bedspace Hub
topics.molo-hub.billing: General rent notices for Molo Bedspace Hub tenants
topics.dormcare.verification: Property verification events for the DormCare admin
